decisions.reason: A certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line close to the core offer costs little to keep, and the lack of negative evidence argues for keeping the option open rather than abandoning it.
Early evidence of strong market share in marine water cooling suggests the option has largely resolved favorably and warrants continued commitment.
The marine cooling unit complements the successful box cooler line at low holding cost, so the option stays open while its value is still being revealed.
Finned tubes are a cheap component option that supports the firm's air cooler business, so keeping it adds strategic value at minimal cost.
Enhanced tubes support efficiency and sustainability gains across the portfolio at low marginal cost, so abandoning the option is not justified.
